say:1:1061701001:1.text: What's happening over there in the forest? The animals just keep making loud noises.
say:1:1061701001:1.source_cn: 不知道林子那边发生了什么事，那些动物一直发出咆哮。
say:1:1061701001:1.male: What's happening over there in the forest? The animals just keep making loud noises.
say:1:1061701001:1.female: What's happening over there in the forest? The animals just keep making loud noises.

say:2:1061701002:1.text: I listened closely just now. It feels like they're angry and getting more riled up by the moment.
say:2:1061701002:1.source_cn: 我刚才凑近听了听，感觉它们像是在发怒，而且越来越暴躁了！
say:2:1061701002:1.male: I listened closely just now. It feels like they're angry and getting more riled up by the moment.
say:2:1061701002:1.female: I listened closely just now. It feels like they're angry and getting more riled up by the moment.

say:3:1061701003:1.text: If this continues, will they come to the village?
say:3:1061701003:1.source_cn: 这样下去，它们会不会跑到村子里来？
say:3:1061701003:1.male: If this continues, will they come to the village?
say:3:1061701003:1.female: If this continues, will they come to the village?

say:4:1061701004:1.text: I wish someone could check on them or, better yet, calm them down...
say:4:1061701004:1.source_cn: 要是有人能帮忙过去看看就好了，最好能安抚那些动物……

choice_prompt:5:1061701004.text: I wish someone could check on them or, better yet, calm them down...
choice_prompt:5:1061701004.source_cn: 要是有人能帮忙过去看看就好了，最好能安抚那些动物……

say:6:1061701005:1.text: That would be great! The whole Ivoryshade would be in your debt.
say:6:1061701005:1.source_cn: 噢，要是你愿意帮这个忙就太好了！月影乡的居民都会感激你的。
say:6:1061701005:1.male: That would be great! The whole Ivoryshade would be in your debt.
say:6:1061701005:1.female: That would be great! The whole Ivoryshade would be in your debt.

say:7:1061701007:1.text: I'll leave you to it then. Keep walking down, and you will see some animals not far away.
say:7:1061701007:1.source_cn: 那这件事就交给你了。你沿着林子里的路就行，走不了多远就...
say:7:1061701007:1.male: I'll leave you to it then. Keep walking down, and you will see some animals not far away.
say:7:1061701007:1.female: I'll leave you to it then. Keep walking down, and you will see some animals not far away.

say:8:1061701008:1.text: May the Deer Spirit bless your safe return.
say:8:1061701008:1.source_cn: 愿鹿灵保佑你平安归来。
say:8:1061701008:1.male: May the Deer Spirit bless your safe return.
say:8:1061701008:1.female: May the Deer Spirit bless your safe return.

say:10:1061701006:1.text: I guess that's another option. I would worry less if they weren't around to threaten Ivoryshade.
say:10:1061701006:1.source_cn: 唉……那也是一种办法。只要它们不危害到月影乡，我就能放...
say:10:1061701006:1.male: I guess that's another option. I would worry less if they weren't around to threaten Ivoryshade.
say:10:1061701006:1.female: I guess that's another option. I would worry less if they weren't around to threaten Ivoryshade.

say:0:1061702001:0.text: The howls and cries are gone. Looks like they were all chased off.
say:0:1061702001:0.source_cn: 咆哮声消失了，看来没有其他发狂的生物了。
say:0:1061702001:0.male: The howls and cries are gone. Looks like they were all chased off.
say:0:1061702001:0.female: The howls and cries are gone. Looks like they were all chased off.

say:1:1061703001:1.text: Blessed Deer Spirit! The howls and cries are gone! Ivoryshade is safe!
say:1:1061703001:1.source_cn: 鹿灵保佑，已经听不到咆哮声了！月影乡平安了！

say:2:1061703002:1.text: As soon as it got quiet, I knew you were successful. I was actually wondering if I should go in and look for you.
say:2:1061703002:1.source_cn: 刚才那些声音一消失，我就知道你成功了，还想着要不要进去...
say:2:1061703002:1.male: As soon as it got quiet, I knew you were successful. I was actually wondering if I should go in and look for you.
say:2:1061703002:1.female: As soon as it got quiet, I knew you were successful. I was actually wondering if I should go in and look for you.

say:3:1061703003:1.text: I was so relieved to see you return safely.
say:3:1061703003:1.source_cn: 见到你平安回来，我就彻底放心啦。
say:3:1061703003:1.male: I was so relieved to see you return safely.
say:3:1061703003:1.female: I was so relieved to see you return safely.

say:4:1061703004:1.text: Take these gifts. This is a tradition of Ivoryshade.
say:4:1061703004:1.source_cn: 给你的一些感谢。这是月影乡的礼节，你就安心收下吧！
say:4:1061703004:1.male: Take these gifts. This is a tradition of Ivoryshade.
say:4:1061703004:1.female: Take these gifts. This is a tradition of Ivoryshade.
